projects.title: SOC Automation Lab
projects.description: A local-first investigation flow for synthetic alerts: validate an event, enrich its context, and make a response decision.
projects.problem: Security event data can be noisy, and a useful investigation needs clear context before a response is chosen.
projects.solution: Planned demonstration: take synthetic events through validation, local enrichment, triage, and human review.

projects.title: Signal / Noise
projects.description: A focused interface study in turning dense operational data into calm, legible decisions.
projects.problem: Important details are easy to miss when interfaces compete for attention.
projects.solution: A visual study of restrained contrast, clear hierarchy, and concise incident summaries.

projects.title: Study-to-Story
projects.description: A human-reviewed workflow concept that turns learning notes into a structured, source-aware video draft.
projects.problem: Turning study notes into a reviewable explainer involves several repeatable steps.
projects.solution: A planned workflow validates notes, drafts a structured script, and pauses for human review before any publishing step.

projects.title: Rohan.OS Terminal
projects.description: A small simulated command line that responds to portfolio-specific prompts without running shell commands.
projects.problem: A portfolio can show personality without exposing a real command runner.
projects.solution: A fixed set of safe, simulated commands returns curated portfolio context.
